stories.title: Trump rejects Iran deal to reopen Strait of Hormuz in seven days
stories.summary: President Trump said he rejected Tehran's proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days, arguing Iran only offered it because it is losing its war with the US. Washington has blockaded Iranian ports and attacked tankers in the strait, hitting Iran's economy hard.

stories.title: 7 dead as Russia, Ukraine exchange strikes and aerial war intensifies
stories.summary: Seven people were killed as Russia and Ukraine traded missile and drone strikes, including two women who died when a Russian strike destroyed a home in Zaporizhzhia. The overnight barrage marks an intensifying aerial war after more than four years of full-scale conflict.

stories.title: AI chip startup Positron valued at $5B as demand surges
stories.summary: AI chip startup Positron was valued at $5 billion in a new funding round as demand for AI processors surges. The raise underscores the heavy capital still flowing into silicon amid the global AI buildout.

stories.title: Tesla ramps Optimus to hundreds a week, but robots still can't generalize
stories.summary: Tesla is now building several hundred Optimus humanoid robots per week at Fremont, roughly ten times its Q2 output and on pace for about 1,000 units a week by year-end. A new report says the hands break and the AI still can't handle generalized tasks, limiting near-term commercial usefulness.

stories.title: Nick Chubb says 'better closure' to retire with Browns
stories.summary: Running back Nick Chubb has returned to Cleveland to sign a one-day contract and retire with the Browns, who will honor him during Sunday's home opener against Carolina. He retires with 7,349 career rushing yards and 59 touchdowns.

stories.title: Ohio State leads Illinois in Big Ten opener at the half
stories.summary: Ohio State is hosting Illinois at Ohio Stadium for its Big Ten opener and leads at halftime behind a big day from receiver Jeremiah Smith. Smith had eight catches for 150 yards and three touchdowns in the first half.

stories.title: 3 halftime observations from Ohio State vs. Illinois
stories.summary: Ohio State went to the locker room ahead of Illinois at halftime in both teams' first Big Ten game of the year, and it has been the Jeremiah Smith show on offense. The Buckeyes are trying to open conference play with a win.

stories.title: Jeremiah Smith sets Ohio State records vs. Illinois
stories.summary: Ohio State receiver Jeremiah Smith set program records against Illinois on Saturday, scoring twice in the first quarter and topping 100 receiving yards by halftime. His production is pacing the Buckeyes in their Big Ten opener.

stories.title: F1 approves shorter races for 2027 to fit revised power unit plan
stories.summary: Formula 1 has approved shorter races for the 2027 season to accommodate a revised power unit plan. The change is part of ongoing adjustments to the sport's technical regulations for the next generation of cars.

stories.title: Guenther Steiner predicts Max Verstappen will go winless in 2026
stories.summary: Former Haas boss Guenther Steiner has predicted Max Verstappen will not win a race in the 2026 F1 season. The forecast adds to scrutiny of Red Bull's competitiveness amid its ongoing car troubles.

stories.title: Red Bull admits Verstappen's car issue can't be fully fixed until 2027
stories.summary: Red Bull has admitted that a mysterious car issue affecting Max Verstappen cannot be fully resolved until 2027. The admission casts doubt on the team's ability to fully challenge this season.

stories.title: Carlos Sainz backs bold approach for Williams junior Will Green
stories.summary: Carlos Sainz has backed the aggressive, bold approach taken by Williams junior driver Will Green as he develops toward a race seat. Sainz says the young driver's attitude bodes well for his future.

stories.title: Central Ohio cities debate Flock camera usage
stories.summary: Several central Ohio cities are weighing whether to keep or limit Flock license-plate camera programs, with Columbus reviewing its own use amid privacy concerns. The debate comes as law enforcement argues the cameras help solve crimes.

stories.title: One killed in South Side Columbus shooting
stories.summary: One person was found dead in an alley in South Columbus after a shooting. Police are investigating the fatal incident, which is the latest violence in the city this year.

stories.title: Columbus gas prices dip but still top $4 a gallon
stories.summary: Gasoline prices in Columbus have dipped slightly but remain above $4 a gallon on average. The modest decline offers little relief for drivers at the pump.

stories.title: Marino's near Grandview gets new owners after 33 years
stories.summary: Marino's, a longtime fish-and-chips staple near Grandview Heights, is getting new owners after more than three decades in business. The future of the community favorite under the new ownership has yet to be detailed.
